Dan Woods

Autoresearching Apple's "LLM in a Flash" to run Qwen 397B locally 自动研究苹果的“快速快速语言模型”以本地运行 Qwen 397B

A couple days ago

I tweeted about an experiment I was running with Claude Code to see if I could get Qwen 3.5 397B running on my MacBook Pro. Not a distilled version or a smaller model, but the actual 397 billion parameter Mixture-of-Experts model that takes up 209 GB on disk, on a machine with 48 GB of RAM.
几天前
我在推特上说我正在用 Claude Code 做一个实验
，看看能否让 Qwen 3.5 397B 在我的 MacBook Pro 上运行。不是精简版或更小的模型，而是实际的 3970 亿参数专家混合模型，磁盘占用 209 GB，机器内存 48 GB。

This is something I've been waiting to become possible ever since I read Apple's

"LLM in a Flash" paper three years ago. The paper laid out a clear thesis for running models that exceed DRAM capacity by streaming weights from flash storage, and Apple had been shipping hardware that seemed purpose-built for exactly this kind of workload. I've been waiting and waiting for Apple to do something with it, and they just haven't. Running really big models locally has been a bit of a white whale for me, because local AI is incredibly compelling but smaller models just aren't very smart, and they still push GPU and memory pretty hard on their own. What I wanted was frontier-class intelligence running on hardware I own, and I've had this assumption for a while now that Apple's architecture should make it possible.
自从三年前读到苹果的
《闪现大语言模型》
论文以来，我一直期待实现这一目标。论文明确提出了通过从闪存存储流式权重来运行超过 DRAM 容量的模型的论点，而苹果一直在发布似乎专门为这类工作负载设计的硬件。我一直在等苹果对它有所作为，但他们就是没有。本地运行超大模型对我来说有点难，因为本地 AI 非常有吸引力，但小模型就不够智能，而且它们仍然会对 GPU 和内存施加很大压力。我想要的是运行在我拥有的硬件上的前沿级智能，我一直有个假设，认为苹果的架构应该能实现这一点。

The thing is, I personally have never been smart enough to be able to do this kind of work on my own. The Metal shaders, the Objective-C inference engine, the low-level I/O optimization, none of that is in my wheelhouse. But the timing has finally come together with everything in the AI ecosystem that made this achievable. Opus 4.6 is incredibly, incredibly smart, and Claude Code makes agentic engineering a real thing that we can actually do now. Anthropic has made it so that tool calls can just run in a loop seemingly forever, which means you can point an agent at a hard problem and let it iterate autonomously. Karpathy's autoresearch methodology came at precisely the right time for me to be able to work through this problem with Claude and make it something that could actually become a reality. All the stars aligned, and it turned out that giving Opus a metric to optimize and a goal to "never stop until you hit this number" was the missing piece.
问题是，我个人从来没有足够聪明，无法独自完成这类工作。Metal 着色器、Objective-C 推理引擎、低层 I/O 优化，这些都不是我的强项。但时机终于与人工智能生态系统中所有使这一目标成为可能的因素完美结合。Opus 4.6 非常非常聪明，而 Claude Code 让智能工程成为我们现在真正能做到的事情。Anthropic 让工具调用可以无限循环运行，这意味着你可以指向一个难题，让它自主迭代。Karpathy 的自动研究方法正好赶上了我用 Claude 解决这个问题、让它成为现实的好时机。所有因素都对齐了，结果发现给 Opus 一个优化指标和“永不停歇直到达到这个数字”的目标，正是缺失的关键。

It ended up working at 5.7 tokens per second sustained with a max token throughput of 7.07, all while preserving production-quality output, using about 5.5 GB of resident memory. And at those speeds, the hardware itself is barely even being touched, which leads me to believe there's quite a lot more we're leaving on the table.
最终，它以每秒 5.7 个令牌的速度运行，最大令牌吞吐量为 7.07，同时保持了生产质量的输出，使用了约 5.5GB 的常驻内存。而且在这种速度下，硬件本身几乎没有被动用，这让我觉得我们还有很多内容要保留。

The paper and code are up at

https://github.com/danveloper/flash-moe.
纸和代码都挂在
https://github.com/danveloper/flash-moe
。

I want to be really clear about something before I go any further, because I think it matters for understanding what this kind of work looks like now. I did not write any of this code. Not the Objective-C inference engine (about 5,000 lines), not the Metal shaders (about 1,100 lines), not the 2-bit requantization pipeline, not the tests. Claude wrote all of it. My role was to give it the idea and the right set of reference materials (the LLM in a Flash paper, brilliant articles from

@maderix who has recently reverse-engineered the Apple Neural Engine, and Karpathy's autoresearch repo), let it loose, and then once it had reached a certain point in the research and started hitting plateaus, to come in and collaborate with it on the performance optimizations and push it to the next level. That collaboration model, where the agent does the implementation work and the human provides direction and systems-level insight at plateau points, ended up being a really effective way to work. The whole journey was about 24 hours and 90 experiments, and 42% of those experiments were discarded. The failures were as informative as the successes.
在继续之前，我想先把一件事弄清楚，因为我认为这对理解现在这类工作是什么样子很重要。这些代码我都没写。不是 Objective-C 的推理引擎（大约 5,000 行），不是 Metal 着色器（大约 1,100 行），不是 2 位重量化流水线，也不是测试。克劳德写了所有这些。我的角色是赋予它灵感和合适的参考资料（比如 Flash 论文中的 LLM、 最近逆向工程苹果神经引擎的
@maderix
精彩文章，以及 Karpathy 的自动研究仓库），放手让它自由发挥，然后当它在研究中达到一定阶段并开始遇到瓶颈时， 与它合作优化性能，推动它迈向新高度。这种协作模式，即代理负责实施工作，人类在瓶颈点提供指导和系统层面洞察，最终成为一种非常有效的工作方式。整个旅程大约持续了 24 小时，进行了 90 个实验，其中 42%的实验被弃置。失败和成功一样具有信息量。

I want to talk about how the system works, but I think the more interesting story is actually about the hardware I ran it on...
我想谈谈这个系统是如何工作的，但我觉得更有趣的故事其实是关于我运行它的硬件......

Every design decision Apple made in pursuit of "thin and light" turned out to help with what we're trying to do here. When they moved everything onto a single chip, they wired the CPU, GPU, and SSD controller together with copper. They did it because it made laptops thinner and more power efficient, but it also means that data moving between storage and the GPU doesn't have bus-hopping costs. My M3 Max does 17.5 GB/s sequential reads from the SSD, which is 3x faster than what Apple measured on the M1 Max in their own “LLM in a Flash” paper, and it all flows through a unified memory architecture where the CPU and GPU share the same physical memory space. On top of everything is the fact that there are hardware caches everywhere along the way. A lot of what this project ended up being was a cache optimization problem, and the most important optimization we found was to stop trying to outsmart the hardware's caches with our own.
苹果为追求“轻薄”所做的每一个设计决策，都帮助实现了我们想要实现的目标。当他们把所有设备都转移到一块芯片上时，CPU、GPU 和 SSD 控制器用铜线连接在一起。他们这样做是因为这让笔记本更薄、更节能，但这也意味着数据在存储和 GPU 之间传输时不会有跳总线的成本。我的 M3 Max 从 SSD 上实现 17.5 GB/s 的顺序读取，比苹果在《闪存中的 LLM》论文中测得的快 3 倍，整个过程都通过统一的内存架构流淌，CPU 和 GPU 共享相同的物理内存空间。更糟的是，整个过程中到处都有硬件缓存。这个项目很大程度上成了一个缓存优化问题，我们发现最重要的优化是停止用自己的缓存来智取硬件缓存。

MoE models turned out to work really well for this because they're absurdly sparse at inference time. Qwen 3.5 397B has 512 experts per layer but only activates 10 per token, and we found you can prune that down to 4 with no quality degradation (K=3 causes immediate quality collapse, which suggests the routing learned to distribute critical computation across exactly 4 experts). That means less than 2% of expert weights are needed for any given token, and we were able to 2-bit requantize the expert weights with negligible quality loss (RMSE of 0.001 to 0.003 per layer), which cut expert storage from 209 GB to 120 GB. So you end up with a relatively small number of relatively small weight blocks to stream from disk per token, and if you can deliver them fast enough, you never need to hold the model in memory at all.
MoE 模型在推理时非常稀疏，所以效果非常好。Qwen 3.5 397B 每层有 512 个专家，但每个令牌只激活 10 个，我们发现你可以将其修剪到 4 个而不会导致质量下降（K=3 会导致质量瞬间崩溃，这表明路由学会了将关键计算分配给恰好 4 个专家）。这意味着每个代币所需的专家权重不到 2%，我们能够以几乎不计较的质量损失（每层 RMSE 0.001 到 0.003）进行 2 位重量化专家权重，将专家存储从 209GB 削减到 120GB。所以每个代币可以从磁盘流式传输的权重块数量相对较少，如果能快速传递它们，你根本不需要把模型存入内存。

That said, the non-deterministic routing in MoE models actually makes cache optimization harder than it would be with a dense architecture, because you don't know in advance which experts you're going to need for the next layer. A thick dense model where the next layer's weights are always predictable would probably be even better for this kind of streaming inference, since you could actually pre-fetch effectively. Something to explore.
话虽如此，MoE 模型中的非确定性路由实际上比密集架构更难优化缓存，因为你无法提前知道下一层需要哪些专家。一个厚且密集的模型，且下一层权重始终可预测，可能更适合这种流式推断，因为你实际上可以有效地预取数据。值得探索的东西。

The inference engine itself is written in Objective-C and Metal Shading Language with no Python anywhere in the hot path and no ML framework. It streams expert weights from disk and runs them through a fused three-command-buffer GPU pipeline where the CPU is loading the next layer's experts while the GPU is still computing the current layer's results.
推理引擎本身用 Objective-C 和 Metal Shading Language 编写，热路径中没有 Python，也没有机器学习框架。它从磁盘流式专家权重，并通过融合的三命令缓冲 GPU 流水线运行，CPU 加载下一层的专家，而 GPU 仍在计算当前层的结果。

The most counterintuitive finding of the whole project was that deleting the carefully engineered 9.8 GB Metal LRU expert cache and just letting macOS handle caching on its own made everything 38% faster. Claude built a sophisticated application-level cache in GPU-visible shared memory, and it was actively hurting us. What was happening was that the Metal cache's GPU-visible pages forced Apple's hardware memory compressor to work continuously at 60,000 to 130,000 decompressions per second, burning 1 to 2 GB/s of memory bandwidth just on housekeeping. Remove the cache, the compressor goes quiet, decompressions drop to near zero, and all that bandwidth becomes available for useful work. This is the same lesson that PostgreSQL's documentation teaches about not building application-level buffer pools that compete with the OS buffer cache, and it ended up being the theme of the whole project: trust the hardware, get the software out of the way.
整个项目中最反直觉的发现是，删除精心设计的 9.8GB Metal LRU 专家缓存，让 macOS 自行处理缓存，使一切速度提升了 38%。Claude 在 GPU 可见的共享内存中构建了一个复杂的应用级缓存，这实际上给我们带来了很大的伤害。发生的情况是，Metal 缓存中 GPU 可见的页面强制苹果硬件内存压缩器以每秒 6 万到 13 万次解压持续运行，仅在维护中就消耗了 1 到 2 GB/s 的内存带宽。移除缓存后，压缩机会安静，解压几乎降到零，所有带宽都可用于有用的工作。这正是 PostgreSQL 文档教给的教训：不要构建与操作系统缓冲区缓存竞争的应用级缓冲池，这也成为了整个项目的主题：信任硬件，先把软件排除在外。

The theoretical throughput floor for this system, limited only by SSD bandwidth, is 18.6 tok/s. We're at 5.7, and the hardware is barely breaking a sweat, which means there's a lot of room left to push. The M4 Max should have around 25 GB/s SSD bandwidth, which gets you to roughly 8 tok/s with zero software changes, and Apple's SSD bandwidth improves about 20% per generation. Within 2 to 3 hardware generations, 10+ tok/s on a 400 billion parameter model on a laptop is just the baseline.
该系统的理论吞吐量下限仅受 SSD 带宽限制，为 18.6 tok/s。我们现在是 5.7，硬件几乎没什么问题，这意味着还有很大的空间可以推。M4 Max 的 SSD 带宽大约是 25 GB/s，这样在没有软件更改的情况下大约能达到 8 tok/s，而苹果的 SSD 带宽每代提升大约 20%。在 2 到 3 代硬件内，笔记本上 4000 亿参数模型的 10+ tok/s 只是基础。

This approach also generalizes beyond Qwen. DeepSeek-V3 at 671B with 37B active is an obvious candidate, and really any MoE model where expert weights dominate total parameters works with this approach.
这种方法也适用于超越 Qwen 的范围。DeepSeek-V3 位于 671B，37B 活跃，是一个显而易见的候选方案，实际上任何专家权重主导总参数的 MoE 模型都适用此方法。

Apple published "LLM in a Flash" three years ago telling everyone that the SSD is a perfectly viable weight store, and then they consistently shipped hardware that proves exactly that. SSD performance is improving every single year, and I’m hopeful that we’ll start to see more and more frontier models from open source labs that just, you know, run on your computer. I’m deeply grateful to the MLX open source community for all the hard work they continue to do to take advantage of Apple hardware’s AI potential. None of this would’ve been possible without having MLX as a starting spot. I’m long on Apple. They have a secret weapon in AI, and we’re just beginning to see its potential.
苹果三年前发布了《快要大型语言模型》，告诉大家 SSD 是一个完全可行的重量存储工具，然后他们不断推出的硬件正是证明这一点的。SSD 的性能每年都在提升，我希望我们能看到越来越多开源实验室推出的前沿型号，这些模型可以直接在你的电脑上运行。我非常感谢 MLX 开源社区，感谢他们持续努力利用苹果硬件 AI 潜力所做的努力。没有 MLX 作为起点，这一切都不可能实现。我对苹果很感兴趣。他们在人工智能中拥有一项秘密武器，而我们才刚刚开始看到它的潜力。

热门回复

@anyIP | Residential & Mobile Proxies ♥ 962 · 💬 0

There’s fast and there’s Cheetah fast. anyIP proxies are Cheetah fast. Translation: anyIP median proxy response time is just 0.539s.

@Simon Willison ♥ 14 · 💬 2

How confident are you with respect to the output quality given the 2-bit quantization and reducing experts from 10 to 4? Did you have a mechanism for measuring that?
考虑到2位量化和将专家从10位减少到4位，你对输出质量有多大信心？你有测量这个的机制吗？

@Dan Woods ♥ 4 · 💬 1

Empirical with Opus doing the sanity checking. I’m not sure 2-bit quantization even mattered that much in the end… it was an earlier test, so I’ll probably revert that and see how it does with regular 4-bit. The k=4 was a binary search by Claude, checking the quality each time.
Empirical，Opus 负责理智检查。我不确定 2 位量化最终是否真的那么重要......这是早期的测试，所以我可能会回退，看看用普通 4 位测试效果如何。k=4 是 Claude 的二分搜索，每次都检查质量。

@Boyuan (Nemo) Chen ♥ 3 · 💬 1

The MoE angle makes this extra interesting. With dense models you can prefetch weights sequentially, but expert routing is basically random from the SSD's perspective. Would love to see someone profile expert activation patterns across different prompts to find a viable caching
魔力的角度让这件事更加有趣。对于密集模型，你可以顺序预取权重，但从 SSD 的角度来看，专家路由基本上是随机的。很想看到有人针对不同提示来分析专家激活模式，找到可行的缓存

@loreii ♥ 3 · 💬 1

我有个问题......大型语言医学的彩虹表......

苹果为追求“轻薄”所做的每一个设计决策，都帮助实现了我们想要实现的目标。当他们把所有设备都转移到一块芯片上时，CPU、GPU 和 SSD 控制器用铜线连接在一起。他们这样做是因为这让笔记本更薄、更节能，但这也意味着数据在存储和 GPU 之间传输时不会有跳总线的成本。我的 M3 Max 从 SSD 上实现 17.5 GB/s 的顺序读取，比苹果在《闪存中的 LLM》论文中测得的快 3 倍，整个过程都通过统一的内存架构流淌，CPU 和 GPU 共享相同的物理内存空间。更糟的是，整个过程中到处都有硬件缓存。这个项目很大程度上成了一个缓存优化问题，我们发现最重要的优化是停止用自己的缓存来智取硬件缓存。
MoE models turned out to work really well for this because they're absurdly sparse at inference time. Qwen 3.5 397B has 512 experts per layer but only activates 10 per token, and we found you can prune that down to 4 with no quality degradation (K=3 causes immediate quality collapse, which suggests the routing learned to distribute critical computation across exactly 4 experts). That means less than 2% of expert weights are needed for any given token, and we were able to 2-bit requantize the expert weights with negligible quality loss (RMSE of 0.001 to 0.003 per layer), which cut expert storage from 209 GB to 120 GB. So you end up with a relatively small number of relatively small weight blocks to stream from disk per token, and if you can deliver them fast enough, you never need to hold the model in memory at all.
MoE 模型在推理时非常稀疏，所以效果非常好。Qwen 3.5 397B 每层有 512 个专家，但每个令牌只激活 10 个，我们发现你可以将其修剪到 4 个而不会导致质量下降（K=3 会导致质量瞬间崩溃，这表明路由学会了将关键计算分配给恰好 4 个专家）。这意味着每个代币所需的专家权重不到 2%，我们能够以几乎不计较的质量损失（每层 RMSE 0.001 到 0.003）进行 2 位重量化专家权重，将专家存储从 209GB 削减到 120GB。所以每个代币可以从磁盘流式传输的权重块数量相对较少，如果能快速传递它们，你根本不需要把模型存入内存。
That said, the non-deterministic routing in MoE models actually makes cache optimization harder than it would be with a dense architecture, because you don't know in advance which experts you're going to need for the next layer. A thick dense model where the next layer's weights are always predictable would probably be even better for this kind of streaming inference, since you could actually pre-fetch effectively. Something to explore.
话虽如此，MoE 模型中的非确定性路由实际上比密集架构更难优化缓存，因为你无法提前知道下一层需要哪些专家。一个厚且密集的模型，且下一层权重始终可预测，可能更适合这种流式推断，因为你实际上可以有效地预取数据。值得探索的东西。
The inference engine itself is written in Objective-C and Metal Shading Language with no Python anywhere in the hot path and no ML framework. It streams expert weights from disk and runs them through a fused three-command-buffer GPU pipeline where the CPU is loading the next layer's experts while the GPU is still computing the current layer's results.
推理引擎本身用 Objective-C 和 Metal Shading Language 编写，热路径中没有 Python，也没有机器学习框架。它从磁盘流式专家权重，并通过融合的三命令缓冲 GPU 流水线运行，CPU 加载下一层的专家，而 GPU 仍在计算当前层的结果。
The most counterintuitive finding of the whole project was that deleting the carefully engineered 9.8 GB Metal LRU expert cache and just letting macOS handle caching on its own made everything 38% faster. Claude built a sophisticated application-level cache in GPU-visible shared memory, and it was actively hurting us. What was happening was that the Metal cache's GPU-visible pages forced Apple's hardware memory compressor to work continuously at 60,000 to 130,000 decompressions per second, burning 1 to 2 GB/s of memory bandwidth just on housekeeping. Remove the cache, the compressor goes quiet, decompressions drop to near zero, and all that bandwidth becomes available for useful work. This is the same lesson that PostgreSQL's documentation teaches about not building application-level buffer pools that compete with the OS buffer cache, and it ended up being the theme of the whole project: trust the hardware, get the software out of the way.
整个项目中最反直觉的发现是，删除精心设计的 9.8GB Metal LRU 专家缓存，让 macOS 自行处理缓存，使一切速度提升了 38%。Claude 在 GPU 可见的共享内存中构建了一个复杂的应用级缓存，这实际上给我们带来了很大的伤害。发生的情况是，Metal 缓存中 GPU 可见的页面强制苹果硬件内存压缩器以每秒 6 万到 13 万次解压持续运行，仅在维护中就消耗了 1 到 2 GB/s 的内存带宽。移除缓存后，压缩机会安静，解压几乎降到零，所有带宽都可用于有用的工作。这正是 PostgreSQL 文档教给的教训：不要构建与操作系统缓冲区缓存竞争的应用级缓冲池，这也成为了整个项目的主题：信任硬件，先把软件排除在外。
The theoretical throughput floor for this system, limited only by SSD bandwidth, is 18.6 tok/s. We're at 5.7, and the hardware is barely breaking a sweat, which means there's a lot of room left to push. The M4 Max should have around 25 GB/s SSD bandwidth, which gets you to roughly 8 tok/s with zero software changes, and Apple's SSD bandwidth improves about 20% per generation. Within 2 to 3 hardware generations, 10+ tok/s on a 400 billion parameter model on a laptop is just the baseline.
该系统的理论吞吐量下限仅受 SSD 带宽限制，为 18.6 tok/s。我们现在是 5.7，硬件几乎没什么问题，这意味着还有很大的空间可以推。M4 Max 的 SSD 带宽大约是 25 GB/s，这样在没有软件更改的情况下大约能达到 8 tok/s，而苹果的 SSD 带宽每代提升大约 20%。在 2 到 3 代硬件内，笔记本上 4000 亿参数模型的 10+ tok/s 只是基础。
This approach also generalizes beyond Qwen. DeepSeek-V3 at 671B with 37B active is an obvious candidate, and really any MoE model where expert weights dominate total parameters works with this approach.
这种方法也适用于超越 Qwen 的范围。DeepSeek-V3 位于 671B，37B 活跃，是一个显而易见的候选方案，实际上任何专家权重主导总参数的 MoE 模型都适用此方法。
Apple published "LLM in a Flash" three years ago telling everyone that the SSD is a perfectly viable weight store, and then they consistently shipped hardware that proves exactly that. SSD performance is improving every single year, and I’m hopeful that we’ll start to see more and more frontier models from open source labs that just, you know, run on your computer. I’m deeply grateful to the MLX open source community for all the hard work they continue to do to take advantage of Apple hardware’s AI potential. None of this would’ve been possible without having MLX as a starting spot. I’m long on Apple. They have a secret weapon in AI, and we’re just beginning to see its potential.
苹果三年前发布了《快要大型语言模型》，告诉大家 SSD 是一个完全可行的重量存储工具，然后他们不断推出的硬件正是证明这一点的。SSD 的性能每年都在提升，我希望我们能看到越来越多开源实验室推出的前沿型号，这些模型可以直接在你的电脑上运行。我非常感谢 MLX 开源社区，感谢他们持续努力利用苹果硬件 AI 潜力所做的努力。没有 MLX 作为起点，这一切都不可能实现。我对苹果很感兴趣。他们在人工智能中拥有一项秘密武器，而我们才刚刚开始看到它的潜力。
